changes: GET /api/v2/org/agent-permissions — removed the required property `results/mode` from the response with the `200` status
PUT /api/v2/org/agent-permissions — removed the required property `results/mode` from the response with the `200` status
POST /api/v2/org/agent-permissions/reset — removed the required property `results/mode` from the response with the `200` status

declaredAdvisories.reason: The organization agent policy no longer has a mode. GET, PUT and POST reset on /api/v2/org/agent-permissions stop returning mode, PUT stops reading it, and @lightdash/common drops it from AgentCapabilityPolicy, AgentCapabilityCeiling and AgentCapabilityPolicySave. A saved capability list now means agents are restricted and null means they are not. The agent-identity flag is off by default on Cloud and on self-hosted, the endpoints refuse callers when it is off, and only the organization and project Agent identity settings pages call them. During a rolling update an old settings tab shows an unrestricted organization as Restrict with every capability on until refresh, and saving from it stores that full list; a new tab cannot save No restrictions through an old pod until the rollout finishes. A PUT without allowedCapabilities now keeps the saved list instead of turning restrictions on.
